fee_waiver.value: Only narrow cases qualify, such as U.S. military veterans or current service members; international students cannot get the economic hardship waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: International students do not qualify for an economic hardship application fee waiver

also.quote: U.S. military veterans or current service members

gre_general.value: The graduate school leaves GRE to each program; some programs require it, so see each program record.
gre_general.quote: Some programs may require GRE scores; check specific program requirements found on each degree page

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.5 for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026 (the new scale).
toefl_min.quote: minimum total score 4.5 (test taken on and after January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.quote: IELTS (International English Language Testing System): minimum overall score of 6.5

english_waiver.value: India is not on the university's list of countries where English is an official language, so Indian applicants need an English test score.
english_waiver.quote: A waiver for the English proficiency requirement is automatically granted to applicants whose education is from countries where English is an official/native language

also.quote: Countries where English is an official language

notes: Conditional admission with pending English proficiency (American Language and Culture Program) is possible for select programs. The 2026-27 catalog (catalog.uidaho.edu) returned HTTP 502 during research, so the program list was built from Degree Finder pages. The Electrical and Chemical Engineering Degree Finder pages still show an old-scale TOEFL of 79.
